Welcome.Title: Bienvenue à Chambres Moulin Neuf
Welcome.IntroPara1: Chambres Moulin Neuf is located in a Maison de Maître built in the early 1900's on the bank of the Charente river in the historic market town of Civray in the Vienne district of central France. The main square, shops, cafes and local amenities are just a few minutes walk from the house.
Welcome.IntroPara2: Located a few kilometers off the RN10 almost equidistant between Poitiers to the north and Angoulême to the south, Civray provides both an excellent base to explore the wider region or a convenient stopping-off point for journeys further south to Spain and Portugal or north to Belgium, Holland and the United Kingdom.
Welcome.IntroPara3: Apart from Poitiers and Angoulême, which are both about one hours drive away, there are easy drives to Niort and onto the coast at La Rochelle to the west, Limoges to the east, and Cognac plus the major historic city of Bordeaux further south. There are also many interesting smaller towns and villages to explore in the area, including Ruffec, Melle, Confolens and Vivonne.
Welcome.AvailabilityPara: Our rooms are available all-year-round from between one night and one month, though minimum stays of more than one night may apply during peak periods, public holidays and special events.
Welcome.BreakfastPara: Guests are welcome to use our dining room and a small guest kitchen with a fridge and a microwave. Both rooms have coffee and tea making facilities provided. We feature some local products, which are also usually available to buy as gifts.
Welcome.MealsPara: We do not provide meals, but brought-in "take away" meals may be eaten in the dining room - or garden in good weather!
Welcome.AccessPara: Rooms are accessed via the original central wooden staircase, which has 36 steps to the top floor and is 65cm wide. There are no disabled access facilities.
Welcome.PetsPara: We have a house cat – Xena – and so welcome small or medium sized well-behaved and cat-friendly pets travelling with their owners. Due to access, the rooms are not suitable for larger pets.
Welcome.ParkingPara: There is unrestricted on-street parking in all the roads surrounding the property and public EV charging points in the car park immediately behind the market square less than five minutes walk away.
Welcome.BikesPara: We can usually offer secure storage in our rear garage and workshop area for bicycles and motorbikes – please enquire at time of booking.
Welcome.GardenPara: Guests are welcome to sit out in our enclosed private garden, which has a small covered pagoda with river views, but please be respectful of our neighbours and the neighbourhood cats!

Spaces.Title: Our Rooms
Spaces.Description: We offer two double rooms on the second (top) floor of the house:
Spaces.ChambreDesc: Our standard double room measuring 16 sqm plus private shower room and views over the front garden and the street.
Spaces.PontDesc: Our queen sized double room measuring 20 sqm plus private shower room with double-aspect views over the garden and towards the river and nearby Grand Pont.
Spaces.SustainabilityPara1: Our electricity comes from a 100% green energy provider who sources the power from their local network of wind farms. We are currently seeking sustainable solutions for our other energy needs.
Spaces.SustainabilityPara2: We provide facilities for guests to recycle packaging, food or other waste produced during their visit within the limits of the municipal recycling facilities provided by our local authority.
Spaces.SustainabilityPara3: Wherever possible we buy from and support local producers and businesses and seek to maintain an ethical supply chain for all our purchases. We do not use businesses or services that are knowingly engaging in tax avoidance, environmental degradation or human and animal exploitation.

Location.AmenitiesPara1: Civray offers everything for your daily needs.
Location.AmenitiesPara2: The town centre features several cafes (at least one is open every day!), restaurants and take-aways, two bakeries, a pharmacy, several banks with ATMs, a tourist information office, library, news agents and a local cinema, which screens a range of French and international films in both original and sub-titled versions.
Location.AmenitiesPara3: There are weekly produce markets in the main square on a Tuesday and Friday. From the square you can also pick up the route for a history walk around the town, starting with a visit to the fabulous Saint Nicholas Church. There are also walks along the river towards Savigné (east) and Saint Pierre d'Exideuil (west) leading further on to the lake at Saint Macoux.
Location.AmenitiesPara4: The town also features the Oda Aquatic Centre, which has an all-year-round indoor swimming pool, seasonal outdoor swimming pool, plus a small fitness suite and spa. During school term times, public access is limited to after school hours and weekends.
Location.AmenitiesPara5: There are two shopping centres on the edge of the town just a couple of minutes drive away featuring larger supermarkets (Intermarché, Super U, Lidl and Aldi), plus further pharmacies, household stores, petrol stations, garages, laundry machines, pizza take-away and a veterinary practice.
Location.TransportRoad: By road: Civray is 10 minutes drive from junction 45 on the RN10 via the D948 in the direction of Limoges. The D948 is also the east-west road linking Niort (for La Rochelle) to Limoges.
Location.TransportTrain: By train: the nearest railway station is approximately 6km away at Saint Saviol, which is on a branch line connecting Poitiers (for services to Paris, La Rochelle, Strasbourg) and Angoulême (for services to Cognac, Saintes, Bordeaux) via Ruffec. The Saint Saviol service runs mainly peak times. There is a bus connecting the station with Civray or we can usually arrange to transport guests to and from the station for a small extra charge.
Location.TransportAir: By Air: there are seasonal international services to and from Poitiers Biard and Limoges airports, and more regular extensive European services from Bordeaux.
Location.TransportCarHire: Car hire: most larger supermarkets in France also offer reasonably priced car hire. These can usually be booked via their app or website (for Intermarché or Super U in Civray) or there is a wider "walk-in" choice usually available at the LeClerc superstore in Ruffec.

Contact.Title: Room booking & reservations
Contact.IntroPara: Please submit your booking or reservation request via the form below, stating your arrival and departure dates, number of guests (minimum one, maximum four) and rooms (one or two). Also please let us know if you are travelling with a pet, require bike storage, have any dietary requirements or allergies we should be aware of, or would like to arrange a station pick-up. It is also useful to know where you are travelling from and your onward destination.
Contact.CheckInPara: Check-in is between 16.00 and 19.00 and check-out up to 11.00 on your day of departure. For times outside of these please let us know and we will try to accommodate.
Contact.DepositPara: We usually require a deposit with all reservations ranging from 25-100% depending on how far in advance you are booking (for bookings within 48 hours of arrival we will ask for full pre-payment). If you need to cancel your booking, please inform us as soon as possible. A full refund will be given if we are able to secure an alternative booking for your dates, or a partial refund will be given if not depending on your notice period.
Contact.ReplyPara: We aim to reply to all enquiries the same day if messages are sent before 20.00.
